name: A quietly missing event
tactic: Delete one line from the middle of the file. A transfer that never happened is easy to explain; a transfer that happened and was un-happened is easier still, if nobody notices the gap.

response.pass: {{ledger}} caught it: the next surviving event still names the deleted one's hash as its predecessor, and it is no longer there to match. {{detail}}
response.fail: {{ledger}} replayed straight through a missing event as if it never existed and nothing referenced it. This must never happen.

text: Every event carries the hash of the one before it, not just a sequence number, so removing a line does not renumber the chain quietly — it orphans the reference the next surviving line makes, and verify() has nothing to match it against.
